name: Eugene Investment & Securities Co.,Ltd.
summary: Eugene Investment & Securities Co.,Ltd. provides various financial services for individual, corporate, and institutional investors. The company offers financial products such as stock/derivatives consignment trading and funds, as well as asset management services; and specialized wealth management services. It also provides digital platforms; customized client solutions for institutional investors, such as ETF LP and market making; and corporate finance solutions comprising IPO, capital increase, corporate bond acquisition, MA consulting, structured finance, and PF.
